implemented_behavior: Strategic Project FKs use enterprise_workspaces.id; legacy projects table is a referenced operational compatibility source, not a new strategic identity.

business_rule: ADMIN configures; USER creates Project Instances
implemented_behavior: Generic ADMIN and live CORE revisions reject new PROJECT identities and lifecycle changes before materialization. Existing canonical PROJECT adoption (including matching USER pending state) remains supported without retroactive process records. Narrow historical CORE migration tooling remains an explicit compatibility exception, not a USER creation route.

business_rule: Idea is a strategic record, not a Workspace
implemented_behavior: Idea records retain owning_workspace_id and do not materialize a Project Workspace.
Idea options/create resolve owning Workspace, effective policy and eligibility.
Proposal is governed source content with review/evaluation and Gate-ready transition, not an investment decision.
APPROVE produces READY_FOR_PORTFOLIO_INTAKE; RETURN/REJECT/DEFER remain distinct states.
ProjectCreationService.materialize inserts EnterpriseWorkspace only after approved request; workspace starts pending, not active.
CONTRACTOR_DELIVERY and DIRECT_INTERNAL use explicit governed creation sources and policy, without default full owner-only gates.
Lifecycle start/validate and activate have separate permissions; validation and independent eligible activation are checked.
Capital target/current/recommended/approved positions do not authorize Budget or Funding.
Portfolio evaluation/prioritization is scoped to the Portfolio; completed assessments preserve their source context.
Portfolio comparisons retain source currency context instead of silently mixing incompatible amounts.
Budget/Resource freeze protects planning alternatives; it does not record formal investment authorization.
Capacity and demand scenarios neither assign named staff nor mutate source Project dates/P6 leveling.
Scenario Convergence records recommendation/hash and combined feasibility, not Gate07K authority.

business_rule: Portfolio HOLD is not Gate HOLD
implemented_behavior: HOLD_FOR_CAPACITY remains Portfolio Governance request context, not investment Gate07K HOLD.
Completed Business Case revisions/snapshots preserve source references and hashes; refresh creates governed successors.
Plan/register/ownership/measures/strategy traceability are strategic; Benefits Realization execution is not released here.
Delivery/packaging/commercial/risk-allocation strategy does not execute procurement.

business_rule: FEL stage differs from PDRI maturity
implemented_behavior: ProjectFELStatus and definition assessments are separate governed entities and readiness concerns.
Availability, validation, quality/confidence/freshness and stage-aware readiness are their own assessment.

business_rule: Risk Governance is reusable ADMIN policy
implemented_behavior: Effective capacity/appetite/threshold configuration is separate from live Project risk readiness.

business_rule: Permit readiness is applicability and coverage
implemented_behavior: Requirements, Project permits and conditions stay governed source evidence, not automatic approval.
Owner maturity, gaps and mitigations do not become resource leveling, contractor capability or Operational Readiness.
FundingSource → Fund → Assignment → Readiness stays a separate authority from portfolio Budget targets/scenarios.
Financial model/version, metrics, debt/investors/scenarios and reconciliation are not Treasury or Accounting mutations.

business_rule: QRA Foundation approval is not result acceptance
implemented_behavior: Only APPROVED_FOR_ANALYSIS models can run; sources/model SoD and currentness precede analysis.
Run COMPLETED plus independent ACCEPTED review are required for provider evidence; creator/executor cannot accept their own result.

business_rule: Provider AVAILABLE is not universal QRA requirement
implemented_behavior: Policy resolves contextual REQUIRED/NOT_REQUIRED/NOT_APPLICABLE/NOT_EVALUABLE per governance/profile/scope/analysis.
Supported Cost and Schedule analyses remain separate; integrated active policy requirement is rejected.
Gate rejects manual references for governed-only evidence and stale mandatory sources block readiness.
FROZEN READY package snapshots include policy/provider/source and criteria hashes; edits are rejected.
Preparation and evidence freeze do not authorize investment; explicit scoped decision actor and authority are needed.
Only profile PYP-FFA plus GO sets is_fid/investment_authorized/full_funds_authorized; SELECT GO is not FID.
Single maker identity/SoD or committee membership/quorum/voting rules must pass; evidence/QRA never auto-decides.
FID event explicitly reports can_activate_project=False; Post-FID evaluates conditions/eligibility separately.

business_rule: Scope is tenant plus assigned context
implemented_behavior: JWT principal fixes tenant/user; enterprise RBAC resolves active time-valid scoped grants, then service checks Workspace visibility.
Clone/preview/validate/publish produces successor configuration; historical snapshots are not rewritten by publishing a policy.
Several legacy authorization helpers bootstrap/commit configuration on GET; inventory did not call them against operational DB.
